name: Deadfall Array 1
description: Lays 5 pitfall traps (1 on you, and 1 in each direction beside you).  Each deals massive pure damage to the first target to step on it.   Damage scales with the enemy's health up to a limit.

name: Death Mark 1
description: Names an enemy for death for 10s.  All damage against target increases by 10%.  Costs 20 malice and returns 15 if the target dies while marked.

name: Shadow Step 1
description: Step through the dark to any creative within 5 tiles, landing at their back.  If there's no free location, it will not cast.  Costs 20 malice and works on both enemies and allies.

name: Shadowlurk 1
description: Shrouds you in darkness for 5s.  Clears all threat and negative effects.
